items.prompt: Why allocate floors first and then largest remainders?

options.text: It is equivalent to independently rounding each quota to the nearest integer
options.why: Independent nearest rounding can change the parent total; largest remainder allocates exactly the leftover count after floors.

options.text: It conserves total and respects quota
options.why: The leftover count is exactly the sum of fractional parts.

options.text: It makes every bucket strictly positive
options.why: Zero weights or small totals can yield 0.

options.text: It removes the need for a tie rule
options.why: Equal remainders still need declared deterministic treatment.

items.explanation: The exact conservation/quota proof follows from the integer target and normalized nonnegative weights.
